caption: A ping-pong ball rests on the head of a drum; the drum is struck once and the ball bounces high off the head.

sa.check: A ping-pong ball rests on the head of a drum.
The ball bounces off the head.
The strike is a single hit.
The strike comes first and the bounce follows.

pc.expect: The ball is still until the strike and leaves the head at the strike.
pc.fail: The ball rises before the stick lands; or hops with the stick held away; or the stick lands and the ball stays seated.

pc.expect: The ball rises, falls back and bounces lower each time in near-vertical arcs.
pc.fail: The ball rises and hangs; or bounces higher on a later bounce with no second strike; or changes direction in mid-air; or stops dead at the top of its arc.

pc.expect: The ball comes back down onto the head or falls off the drum.
pc.fail: The ball floats upward out of view; or drifts sideways at a steady height; or comes to rest in the air.

pc.expect: The head flexes as a skin, the stick rebounds and the ball stays round.
pc.fail: The stick sinks into the head; or the ball squashes flat and stays so; or the head tears.

pc.expect: One ball, one drum, one stick; the stick does not pass through the head.
pc.fail: A second ball appears; or the ball vanishes in mid-air; or the stick passes through the head; or the drum changes shape.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The ball's colour and size, the drum's shell and the stick stay the same.
pc.fail: The ball changes colour or size; or the drum changes colour; or the stick changes length.
